program.name: Slow Burn
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: A Pilates warm-up, strength with a three-second lowering and a yin finish of long, quiet holds.
program.about: Strength that is slow on purpose. A Pilates mat series opens each session, then dumbbell or kettlebell strength with a slow lowering at Levels II and III, so every rep takes longer and asks more of the muscle. The finish is yin: three floor stretches held for a minute and a half or more, not seconds, with nothing to push through. Lower, upper and full-body days rotate. Level II slows the lowering to three seconds and Level III keeps it, while the Pilates gets more reps and the yin holds get longer. Good after a noisy week.
program.split: Lower / upper / full body: Pilates, slow lifting and a yin finish
program.gear: A pair of dumbbells or a kettlebell, and a mat.
